title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode4 Weekend Garage

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Here's your Café au lait. Enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Where's your apron, Dad? Are you going somewhere?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I just got a call that those good coffee beans are in stock. I'll be back in time to open the bar. Keep an eye on things until then, will you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Roger that. We've only got the one customer right now, so take your time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (N-Now it's just the two of us...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm? You're not nervous, are you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... S-Sorry!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. Relax, there's no reason to be so uptight. Judging from your uniform, I take it you go to Miyamasuzaka. We're probably about the same age, too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The same age? I-I'm a freshman.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew it! I'm a 1st year student at Kamiyama High School.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're a 1st year student too? I was sure you were older than me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! My name's An Shiraishi. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'm Kohane Azusawa! I-It's nice to meet you, um...Miss Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Call me An. We're the same age, after all.
You know, I'm really glad you came back, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place really doesn't get many female customers. It's mostly guys who look up to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That was your dad who just left, right?
I understand he's the owner and a pretty famous musician...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! You know your stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I just looked it up online.
It said he used to be active in the music scene here on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he was for a long time, but he retired about two years ago and opened this place, so a lot of his old friends and fans come by.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that who those people were that you were singing with before?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yep. They're musicians who are big fans of my dad. They ask me to sing with them at events all the time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Events? Do you sing at a lot of events, then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yep, sure do.
There are a lot of clubs around here, so it's pretty easy to find gigs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That explains why you seem so used to it.
You looked so cool when I saw you last time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Last time? Oh, you mean when you stopped by before?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah. Y-You were so good!
Actually, I-I was hoping to hear you again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, so that's why you came back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, how about I sing a song?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's just me this time, so it won't be quite the same as the mic relay, but here goes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! Wh-What should I do? M-My body's not ready...
song00001_on_s

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This really is completely different than the video. My heart is racing again!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew! What did you—hm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You...were so cool! Thank you, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Especially the part where you were freestyling!
The part that goes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ——♪ Then there was that other part where you were like ～～♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the way you ended it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane. Can you sing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't you try singing real quick? Like you did just now. It sounds like you've got the lyrics memorized, too. Here's the mic!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait! I-I can't sing in such a public place!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Please?! I really want to hear you sing!
Don't worry, I'm sure you'll be great, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-If it's just a little, then all right...
But...promise you won't laugh, all right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No problem!
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I knew it!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Her rhythm's a little off, and she's not quite singing from the heart, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Her voice! It's gentle, but it also carries in just the right way! But that's not the only thing!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It just makes me want to sing with her!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... That...felt great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I found you! I've finally found you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's team up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's sweep the world off its feet with our performances!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
